description: A PHP class 'GenericRestController' that extends 'AbstractRestController' to handle REST API requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for resources, utilizing various API endpoint classes and validation rules within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: GenericRestController
classes.description: A controller class for handling REST API requests for resources, supporting CRUD operations with validation and response preparation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the API endpoint based on request attributes, ensuring it is a ResourceEndpoint or CollectionEndpoint.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles GET requests, retrieving either a single resource or a collection based on request parameters.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for GET requests depending on whether it's a single resource or collection.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new resources, ensuring the endpoint supports creation.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for POST requests.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update existing resources, ensuring the endpoint supports updates.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for PUT requests.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests, supporting deletion of resources.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for DELETE requests.

methods.name: getNotInstanceOfException
methods.description: Generates an exception if the API endpoint is not of the expected class type.

methods.name: isGetOneRequest
methods.description: Determines if the request is for a single resource based on request attributes.

methods.name: getPreparedResponseParamsFromResult
methods.description: Prepares response parameters from the result object, including metadata and relationships.
